title: Sales experience and model sold
summary: This topic centers on how the car was sold, with one clear positive note about a helpful salesperson and several fragments that mention being sold the wrong or basic version without enough context to classify sentiment confidently.

positive.summary: The positive review praises a salesperson for being very helpful during the sale.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined fragments mention being sold the wrong model, buying as seen, and being pushed toward a basic version with added options, but the examples are too limited to assign clear overall sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the topic signal is weakly classifiable.
The cluster combines different sales-related issues, including salesperson helpfulness, model choice, as-seen sale terms, and trim or options configuration.
Examples are insufficient to determine whether these comments reflect dissatisfaction, acceptance, or later resolution in several cases.
